extraction.keep: case rect; 24 field-bank groups; associated exterior pin-pill labels; 24 bank-title labels; four side-title labels; required definitions/styles
extraction.omit: internal board-connector groups, internal paths, stage components, rating pills, internal labels, source anchors, below-case supplemental pinout sheets; service ports excluded by green-border-only request
extraction.pill_warning: pin pills and titles are appended as independent root siblings; select by computed per-bank anchor/label geometry, not field-bank descendants
extraction.gadgeteer: GA–GI are nine separate J32–J40 ten-pin header cards, not exterior green terminals. Show source-backed separate extension cards when used.

prime.electrical_revision: P12 Prime2590; explorer artwork P11 Prime2660
prime.reuse: Keep board substrate/mask and only actual illustrated connector pcb-part groups from layer-illustrated-f with original transforms. Hide silks; exclude layer-invented-f and synthetic layer-components-f. Prefix SVG IDs and references before embedding. Use P12 pad coordinates translated to explorer frame; correct J16 +0.025/−0.025 mm if claiming P12 positions.
prime.correspondence_summary: 45 J references exist both revisions; all contact function suffixes match. Only J16 center changes. J5 library string differs; pad positions match. J42 spelling and J5–J8 hierarchy changes do not change physical functions. This is connector-level correspondence, not full-board equivalence.

contact_function_readback.method: Compare net function sets by physical pin number, retaining repeated-number pad geometry separately.

renderer_affected: BOX_SIDES, PRIME_SIDES, BANK_ORDER: replace invented bank placement with source coordinate registry
_terminal_identity and _controller_label: map exact border contracts, preserve full physical identities
render_centered_wiring: central shell and banks, unused banks, orientation-dependent peripheral placement, orthogonal tracks, solid functional color styling, conflict notes
_paired_cells: descriptive functional wire labels primary, connection IDs secondary grey
_promotion_group / _assembly_title: physical terminal grouping and actual source device assembly placement
risks: Source SmoothieBox is proposed carrier/harness artwork, not certification of installed hardware; preserve provenance qualification.
1000px central-cell scaling makes original 12px source pill type about 4px; preserve relative geometry but plan readable annotations/output scale rather than silently shrinking labels.
PWM bank has four terminals; PROBE combines servo and probe with shared ground; do not restore old simplified banks.
Ground symbols must retain isolated/domain identities.
Solid styling requires explicit textual GUESS/OPEN evidence states elsewhere; no electrical evidence upgrade.
Alternative operating modes need separate subdiagrams; connector location alone is not electrical suitability.
P11 connector artwork reuse does not imply P11 driver circuitry matches P12.
